25 | Apostate’s Judgment | 1 target | 1 rnd/5 fail | 100’ | Fm

50 | Divine Wrath | 1'R/lvl | - | self | F

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Detects the total number of “enemies” (giving approximate direction and
distance). This spell also reveals the most heavily represented type of enemy
(by total levels). Caster can concentrate on a different 50’R each round.
@@ 2
As Detect Enemies I, except it detects creatures “of darkness”.
@@ 3
Adds +15 to the caster’s melee or missile attack for the current round.
@@ 4
Caster calls down a vertical column of holy light upon one target. Target must
make a RR or suffer an ‘A’ Holy Spell critical. If the creature is an “enemy”
or “of darkness,” the RR is modified by -20, and the critical is of severity
‘B’.
@@ 5
The caster’s next melee or missile attack against an “enemy” of the caster’s
religion or a creature “of darkness” inflicts an additional Holy Weapon
critical that is two levels lower than any normal critical delivered (i.e., a
‘c’ critical would inflict an additional ‘A’ Holy Weapon critical, a ‘B’
critical would inflict an ‘A’ Holy Weapon critical with a special modification
of -25, an ‘A’ critical would inflict an ‘A’ Holy Weapon critical with a
special modification of -50)The attack must occur in the round this spell is
cast.
@@ 6
As Holy Attack I, except the bonus is +20.
@@ 7
Target “enemy” or target creature “of darkness” takes 2d10 hits. He also
operates at -20 to all actions for the duration.
@@ 8
As Holy BIast I, except that the critical is a 'B' for normal targets, and a
‘c’ if an “enemy” or “of darkness”.
@@ 9
As Detect Enemies I, except for range and area of effect.
@@ 10
As Holy Attack I, except the bonus is +25.
@@ 11
As Holy Strike I, except the critical is one level lower in severity (i.e., a
‘B’ critical would inflict an additional 'A' Holy Weapon critical, an ‘A’
critical would inflict an ‘A’ Holy Weapon critical with a special modification
of -25).
@@ 12
As Holy Blast I, except the critical is a ‘c’ for normal targets, and a ‘D’ if
an “enemy” or “of darkness”.
@@ 13
As Heathen’s Judgment I, except target takes 4d10 hits and the penalty is -40.
@@ 14
As Holy Attack I, except the bonus is +30.
@@ 15
As Heathen’s Judgment I, except target takes 8d10 hits and is paralyzed.
@@ 16
As Holy Blast I, except that the critical is a ‘D’ for normal targets, and an
‘E’ if an “enemy” or “of darkness”.
@@ 17
As Heathen’s Judgment I, except target takes 6d10 hits and the penalty is -60.
@@ 18
As Holy Attack I, except the bonus is +35.
@@ 19
As Detect Enemies I, except for range and area of effect.
@@ 20
As Holy Blast I, except that the critical is an ‘E’ for normal targets, and
two ‘E’ criticals if an “enemy” or “of darkness”.
@@ 25
As Heathen’s Judgment I, except target takes 10d10 hits and is knocked
unconscious.
@@ 30
As Holy Blast I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster.
@@ 50
Caster exposes all within the area of effect to the raw power of his deity.
All in the area of effect must make a RR. Failure indicates one ‘E’ Holy Spell
critical for every 10 failure. (Failure by 1-10 = 1 critical; by 11-20 = 2
criticals; etc). The caster is immune to the damage. Creatures “of darkness”
and “enemies” of the caster suffer a special penalty of -20 to their RR.
